# One-time: Promulgate the Table of Ranks (age_5_absolutism or 1670+, hard cost & noble backlash).
oe_rem_dec_table_of_ranks = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        oe_rem_is_rus_host_candidate = yes
        OR = { current_year >= 1670 oe_rem_in_absolutism_or_later = yes }
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rem_ranks_done } NOT = { var:oe_rem_ranks_done = 1 } }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 200
        stability >= 0
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_rem_dec_table_of_ranks.a
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_rem_ranks_done value = 1 }
            add_gold = -200
            add_stability = -3
            add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_table_of_ranks_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}
